faq.a: Ramatu is associated with the Arabic form رَحْمَة, whose core sense is ramatu; mercy (hausa form).

faq.q: What is the origin of Ramatu?
faq.a: Ramatu is associated with Arabic. Ramatu is the Hausa form of Arabic رَحْمَة (Raḥma), meaning 'mercy'.
Yes — the underlying form رَحْمَة is Arabic.
Ramatu can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Ramatu should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Raḥma is not a Quranic personal name.

faq.q: What does Ramatu mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Ramatu is rendered رحمت and carries the sense رحمت، رحم.

faq.q: What does Ramatu mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Ramatu is rendered رحمت and carries the sense رحمت، رحمت.
A romanized syllable approximation is ra-ma-tu. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Ramatu?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Ramatu, ramatu. Script forms are رحمت, رَحْمَة, रहमतु.

faq.q: Is Ramatu a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as female. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
